description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh:
组件类型。支持镜像构建组件和测试组件。

取值范围：
- Build
- Test

默认值：Build。
> 构建组件只能在构建模板中使用，测试组件只能在测试模板中使用。
description.en:
The component type. Image build components and test components are supported.

Valid values:
- Build
- Test

Default value: Build.
> Build components can be used only in build templates, and test components can be used only in test templates.

description.zh:
组件版本号，与组件名称配合使用，格式为major.minor.patch，均为非负整数。

默认值：(x+1).0.0，x为当前组件最大的major版本号。
description.en:
The component version number. This parameter is used together with the component name. The format is major.minor.patch, where all values are non-negative integers.

Default value: (x+1).0.0, where x is the current maximum major version number of the component.

description.zh: 组件内容。由多条命令组成，命令内容不能超过16KB。支持的命令和命令格式详情，请参见[镜像构建服务支持的命令说明](~~200206~~)。
description.en: The component content. The content consists of multiple commands and cannot exceed 16 KB. For more information about supported commands and command formats, see [Commands supported by Image Builder](~~200206~~).

description.zh: 描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以http://和https://开头。
description.en: The description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

description.zh:
组件名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://和https://开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）。

> 不设置`Name`时，默认使用`ImageComponentId`返回值。
description.en:
The component name. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. The name cannot start with http:// or https://. The name can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, colons (:), underscores (_), periods (.), or hyphens (-).

> If you do not specify `Name`, the `ImageComponentId` return value is used by default.

description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
The ID of the enterprise resource group.

description.zh:
组件支持的操作系统。

取值范围：
- Linux
- Windows

默认值：Linux。
description.en:
The operating system supported by the component.

Valid values:
- Linux
- Windows

Default value: Linux.

description.zh: 标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The key of the tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. The tag key cannot contain http:// or https://.

description.zh: 标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The value of the tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with acs:. The tag value cannot contain http:// or https://.

descriptions.zh:
## 接口说明

创建镜像组件前，您需要注意：

- 仅支持创建您自定义的镜像组件。
- 相同名称的组件版本号不能重复，当在模板中使用组件时，可以通过名称和版本号进行引用。
- 镜像组件的内容大小不能超过16 KB。支持的命令详情，请参见[镜像构建服务支持的命令说明](~~200206~~)。

更多信息，请参见[镜像构建概述](~~197410~~)。
descriptions.en:
## Operation description

Before you create an image component, take note of the following items:

- Only custom image components can be created.
- Component version numbers must be unique for the same component name. When using a component in a template, you can reference it by name and version number.
- The content size of an image component cannot exceed 16 KB. For details about supported commands, see [Commands supported by Image Builder](~~200206~~).

For more information, see [Image Builder overview](~~197410~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs create-image-component --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --name testComponent --description This_is_description. --system-type Linux --component-type Build --content Tasks:_-_Name:_HelloWorld_Action:_RunShellCommand_Properties:_commandContent:_echo_hello_world --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --component-version 1.0.0 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs CreateImageComponent --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --ComponentType Build --Description 'This_is_description.' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --Content 'Tasks:_-_Name:_HelloWorld_Action:_RunShellCommand_Properties:_commandContent:_echo_hello_world' --Tag.1.Value TestValue --SystemType Linux --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --Name testComponent --ComponentVersion '1.0.0'
